website.function: Explain SENZ, describe services and these products accurately, and take inquiries. It does not sign people in, take payment for an app plan, grant a license, or run a product.

app.function: Run these products only after SENZ staff verify payment or a signed agreement. Products still in development are listed and cannot be used until SENZ staff record a pilot. It is not the public website, and creating an account does not grant access.

rules: The app catalog is the only description of what a product does. The website repeats it and does not invent features.
Do not link the website to the app while app.released is false.
Do not describe a product as ticketing, voting, tabulation, a clone studio, staff photo retouching, or a public music chart.
FotoLab and Music Platform stay in the product list and are parked. They are not offered on a plan.

QR Menu, Booking, Digital Catalog, Business Website, CRM, POS and Inventory, and Loyalty are SENZ products rebuilt from Fox Syli. They are listed and not offered until SENZ records a pilot. Do not use the Fox Syli name for them.
Service prices on the website are for SENZ engagements. App plan prices stay unset until the owner enters them. There is no checkout.

products.name: SENZ AI Workspace
products.function: Draft, summarize, rewrite, and structure real work with saved, versioned outputs.
products.doesNot: Uses only what you provide. It does not browse the web, send, or publish anything, and every draft needs human review.

products.name: SENZ Communications Intelligence
products.function: Message briefs, stakeholder plans, clarity reviews, and issue preparation with human approval.
products.doesNot: It does not publish or send messages, and it does not replace legal advice or a crisis team.

products.name: SENZ Digital Assistant
products.function: An assistant that answers only from your approved knowledge and hands off to a person.
products.doesNot: It replies only from your approved knowledge: an answer must cite it, and every number, date, price, or contact detail must appear in what it cites, or the question goes to your team. It does not take payments or make bookings.

products.name: SENZ FotoLab
products.function: Private photo projects with real non-destructive adjustments, versions, and export.
products.doesNot: A self-service editor, not a retouching service by SENZ staff. It does not generate or alter images with AI.

products.name: SENZ Client Portal
products.function: Contracted project workspace for milestones, deliverables, revisions, and approvals.
products.doesNot: Set up by SENZ for each contract. It is not a general CRM, form builder, or public file-sharing service.

products.name: SENZ Event Systems
products.function: Event publishing, capacity-safe RSVP, waitlists, check-in, and attendee export.
products.doesNot: It does not sell tickets or run voting or tabulation.

products.name: SENZ Digital Representative
products.function: Consent-based, disclosed text representative for a brand or person, with human approval.
products.doesNot: Text only. It has no voice or video likeness and is never presented as the real person.

products.name: SENZ Music Platform
products.function: Protected audio previews, timestamped feedback, rights confirmation, and delivery.
products.doesNot: It does not stream music to the public, publish charts, or generate music.

products.name: SENZ QR Menu
products.function: A public menu with a QR code, sections, prices, dietary tags, and sold-out items.
products.doesNot: Dietary information is entered by the business and is not checked by SENZ. It does not take orders or payments; guests show their list to staff.

products.name: SENZ Booking
products.function: Online appointment requests that you confirm, with no double-booking.
products.doesNot: It does not take payments or deposits and sends no messages or reminders; you contact customers yourself.

products.name: SENZ Digital Catalog
products.function: A shareable product catalog with search and inquiry lists.
products.doesNot: It does not take orders or payments or track stock; you reply to each inquiry yourself.

products.name: SENZ Business Website
products.function: A one-page business website with services, FAQ, photos, and an inquiry inbox.
products.doesNot: It is hosted at a SENZ web address: custom domains, online payments, and online stores are not included.

products.name: SENZ CRM
products.function: Contacts, stages, follow-ups, and notes for a small team.
products.doesNot: It does not send emails or messages and does not import contacts from other systems.

products.name: SENZ POS and Inventory
products.function: Counter sales, stock counts, and daily totals.
products.doesNot: It records sales and stock only. It is not a BIR-registered POS, does not issue official receipts or invoices, and does not process card or e-wallet payments.

products.name: SENZ Loyalty
products.function: A digital stamp card tied to your counter sales.
products.doesNot: It sends no messages and has no public member page; members ask your staff for their card. A voided POS sale takes back its stamp.
